meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 在跑重计算任务前,它检测 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘,在当前目录生成 .claude_resources.json,并附上并行、内存、GPU 加速等策略建议。
howto.when: 在数据分析、模型训练、大文件处理等重计算任务开始前触发;或当你要求做资源相关规划时。

say.text: 先检测一下这台机器的资源,再决定怎么跑分析
我要训练神经网络,看看有没有可用的 GPU 和后端
say.note: 报告 Metal、CUDA 等可用后端

say.text: 处理 1 万个文件,建议用多少个并行 worker?
say.note: 给出建议 worker 数与可用库

howto.what_en: Before heavy compute, it detects CPU, GPU, memory and disk, writes a .claude_resources.json snapshot in the working directory, and adds parallel, memory and GPU strategy recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered before computationally intensive work such as data analysis, model training or large file processing, or when you ask for resource-aware planning.

say_en.text: Check this machine's resources before deciding how to run the analysis
I want to train a neural net — see what GPU backends are available
Processing 10,000 files — how many parallel workers do you suggest?
